senses.gloss: m. (mostly as collect. noun; cmp. צבט, צבת) luggage, bag, bags.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 73b">B. Mets. 73ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 46a">Yeb. 46ᵃ</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="I00670"><he>טַפְסָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Taanit 21a:11">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מלא ס׳ דאבנים וכ׳</he> (omitted in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) a load of precious stones &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 21a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>שקלינהו לסִיפְטֵיה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שקלו כל מה דהוה בסיפטיהו</he>) they took out (the contents of) his bags and filled them with earth.

<cite ref="Taanit 21a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>שרינהו לס׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לסַיפְטַיְהוּ</he>; Ms. M. 2 everywhere <he>טפס׳</he>) they untied his bags; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a">Snh. 109ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 312">Yalk. Is. 312</cite> (Ms. <he>ספת׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. to Taan. l. c. note).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:6">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>אותביה בס׳</he> he put it (the skull) into a bag; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 104a:9">ib. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>בסִיפְתָּא</he>.
